title.en: Legislative Analyst's analysis of Proposition 43, Official Voter Information Guide
Attorney General's title and summary of Proposition 43, with the Analyst's fiscal estimate, Official Voter Information Guide

explanation.en: With a two-thirds threshold, a bit over one-third voting no defeats a measure, which matches the claim's arithmetic. The Analyst says the new threshold applies to local special taxes proposed by voters, beginning January 1, 2027, not to every local decision.

description.en: Official Voter Information Guide, argument against Proposition 43

sourceTitle.en: Official Voter Information Guide, November 3, 2026 General Election: arguments and rebuttals on Proposition 43

text: Prop. 43 undermines the voice of voters and the majority vote by letting just one-third of voters (33.4%) block local voter decisions
